Leyline Attunement

You don’t just cross the world. You listen to it.

Rules

When you take a Scene Break, you may attune to the local flow. Until your next Soma Break, you gain one of the following benefits (choose when you attune):

  • Guidance of the Current: You reroll the lowest die on one Athletics (Violence) checks you make each hour of travel.
  • Quiet Step: You reroll the lowest die on one Stealth (Intrigue) checks you make each hour of travel.
  • Resonant Warning: You reroll the lowest die on Initiative (Intrigue) rolls made in the first combat after you begin travel.

You can change the chosen benefit each time you attune.

⚙ The initiative / Athletics / Stealth rerolls are wired with the attunement named as the gate — the GM reads which you chose.
